name: Echoes of the Spells

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-09: The Power of Legends

text: The potency of Spellmasters past flows through you. When you Identify Magic, Recall Knowledge, or Trick Magic Item, you can spend a Mythic Point to make the check at mythic proficiency. The first time each day that you critically succeed on a check with a skill corresponding to any magical traditions you possess while Identifying Magic, Recalling Knowledge, or Tricking a Magic Item, you regain a Mythic Point.
